race.comment: JULIE'S GIRL (2) finds it hard to win but looks close to breaking through. Finished in the minors last time when second (24.47) at this track making it back to back placings. Overdue and is among the main hopes. DR. AXEL (1) turned spotting a big start finishing sixth (24.91) last time in a Grade 5 at Sale. Can measure up this time. STORM COMING (6) has a strong record here with four wins and two placings from eight starts. Missed the frame latest (19.99) when eighth over 350m at Healesville in a Grade 5. Can feature with the right run. AUDACIOUS PADDY (3) can find the frame without surprising. Something for the Multiples: SMOOTH BEAUTY (7)
